interpretation: Training examples are constructed only from the training split; both evaluations label the frozen evaluation candidates.
The score selects rankings outside the label estimators but is not an input to compatibility training or either verifier.
Primary status labels do not construct training rows and are not read by the point/mesh audit.
Training counterfactuals and the primary verifier share a subset of OBB primitives and family thresholds.
The alternative audit measures reconstructed point-cloud vertices and mesh triangles directly.
The two evaluations use the same official validation scenes and fixed candidate identities.
All components share the scoped support/contact, proximity, and vertical-order ontology.
